explanation: Those chosen by God based on His eternal plan, not human merit.
The third person of the Trinity who cleanses believers and empowers them to live a holy life.
The state in which a Christian receives new life through God's grace and word, like being born as a new creation.
The eternal reward in heaven that cannot be destroyed or taken from believers.
A reminder of something valuable and pure; here used metaphorically to describe trials that refine faith to a value higher than gold.
To be exposed to difficulties or sufferings to test and strengthen the truth of one's faith.
The state of deep, inner joy that arises when seeing Jesus Christ even though one has not seen Him physically.
Liberation from the penalty and power of sin through Jesus Christ's sacrificial death and resurrection.
